environment_blocked_cells.reason: No independently provisioned recovery host and approved private backup transfer path
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Two independently isolated hosts, separately owned storage and verified encrypted backup transport; a fresh recovery database/file target with capacity for the original dataset plus backup/restore temporary space and the 15% disk/inode and 10% RAM reserves. Record unchanged RPO/RTO, credentials and checksum/row/file reconciliation before starting.

environment_blocked_cells.reason: No configured real WAL archive/repository and recovery target
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Dedicated PostgreSQL 17/systemd host with real pgBackRest, verified-TLS S3 repository and generated fixture credentials; independent fresh restore target, continuous timestamped acknowledged-write ledger, retained base backups/WAL and enough bounded repository/target disk for the complete replay window plus reserves. The marker-only error adapter is not a substitute.

environment_blocked_cells.reason: No owned public staging hostname, DNS control and reachable ACME ingress
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Dedicated public staging address and domain with narrowly scoped DNS credentials, verified authority/provenance, ports 80/443 available and bounded traffic; disposable Caddy/ACME certificate lifecycle, renewal/reload tests and unchanged TLS validation. A local CA is not public ACME evidence.

Dedicated Linux ARM64 machine with Docker/systemd as applicable, compatible pinned toolchain and native provider/generator images; at least the original effective CPU slots (3 disk/4 S3), measured per-component RAM/disk budgets and original reserves. Emulation does not satisfy the native architecture cell.

environment_blocked_cells.reason: No independently isolated generator host/network measurement path
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Dedicated target host plus separate generator machine and controlled network; generator capacity above the declared offered load, measured saturation/drops/steal and network limits, TLS enabled, synchronized metadata and monotonic local measurements. Co-located CPU affinity is not off-host capacity evidence.

environment_blocked_cells.reason: Current disk cannot fit the declared physical fixtures and root reserve
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Disposable host with ten independent project PostgreSQL/file/JWT fixtures at the original sizes, provider and proxy as applicable, declared aggregate CPU/RAM plus OS/controller/generator headroom. The last projection required 16,062,994,022.4 free bytes including reserve; provision additional physical disk headroom for telemetry, WAL, temporary files and full-run growth before admission. Do not delete caches, shrink fixtures, oversubscribe silently or retry on this host.

environment_blocked_cells.reason: No separately reserved uninterrupted 24-hour staging window compatible with the remaining ordered campaigns and hard deadline
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Dedicated disposable host, independent observer/watchdog and resource/storage reservation for 24 uninterrupted measured hours plus preparation and safe cleanup; original traffic, SLOs, reserves, recovery and evidence retention. Short campaigns cannot be added together to claim this cell.

environment_blocked_cells.cell: Power loss beyond VM process cuts
environment_blocked_cells.reason: No isolated physical power/storage fault apparatus
environment_blocked_cells.required_staging_profile: Dedicated nonproduction hardware or equivalently controlled infrastructure exposing real host/storage power interruption, independently durable acknowledged-write witness and diagnostics, externally controlled recovery/power cycle and restore material. QEMU process/RAM cuts do not prove controller-cache or physical-media durability.
